content.comment_body: Hello, I have a client who requires a system that will send an SMS notification if there is a power failure, whether due to network issues, RCD, circuit breakers, etc. I have already installed a [product_name] for basic automation in the electrical panel. Upon checking the specifications for the [product_name] modules, it seems that neither version includes a backup battery. I'm wondering how an SMS alert for power failure could be sent if the power supply to the module is lost?

analysis.insight_summary: The user points out a limitation in the [product_name] mobile communication modules, specifically the absence of integrated backup power. Without backup, these modules cannot send SMS alerts during power outages, which poses issues for users needing reliable notification and monitoring in case of energy loss.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] mobile communication module to send SMS notifications even if a power failure occurs, meaning it should remain functional during such events.
